_comment: Hand-authored Author Landing backlog. Loaded via scripts/load-example-features.mjs as a fallback when the AI Bootstrapper's tool-calling path fails — see docs/author-landing-app-requirements.md for the full spec and the screenshot trail. Same prescriptive style as docs/example-app-features.json: each description names the exact files / bash commands the agent must execute, so smaller models that tend to read-but-not-write get a clear nudge toward actual implementation.

features.title: Scaffold Next.js app
features.description:
ACTION: scaffold a Next.js 16 App Router project IN THE CURRENT WORKING DIRECTORY (your shell cwd IS the project root — do NOT cd elsewhere, do NOT use absolute paths).

STEPS YOU MUST EXECUTE:
1. Run `npx create-next-app@latest . --typescript --tailwind --use-npm --yes --skip-install` via Bash. The `.` makes it scaffold INTO cwd. If it complains the directory is not empty, mv any conflicting hidden folders aside, then retry.
2. Run `npm install` via Bash to install dependencies.
3. Use Read on `package.json` to verify `next`, `react`, `react-dom`, `tailwindcss` are listed.

Do NOT just plan or describe — EXECUTE the bash commands. The session is incomplete unless `package.json` and `app/` exist on disk afterwards.
features.acceptanceCriteria:
- package.json lists next, react, react-dom, tailwindcss
- app/page.tsx and app/layout.tsx exist
- node_modules/ exists (npm install ran)
- npm run dev would listen on http://localhost:3000

features.title: Add SQLite and Drizzle ORM
features.acceptanceCriteria:
- lib/db.ts exists and exports a `db` Drizzle instance
- drizzle.config.ts exists and references ./lib/schema.ts and ./drizzle
- package.json now lists better-sqlite3, drizzle-orm, drizzle-kit, @types/better-sqlite3
- node_modules/better-sqlite3 exists

features.title: Define subscribers schema and migrate
features.acceptanceCriteria:
- lib/schema.ts exists with the subscribers table (id, email UNIQUE, createdAt)
- ./drizzle/ contains at least one .sql migration file
- data.sqlite exists at the project root
- A no-op `npx drizzle-kit generate` afterwards reports no schema changes

features.title: Subscribe API
features.description:
ACTION: add the POST API for newsletter signups.

FILE YOU MUST CREATE (use Write):
- `app/api/subscribe/route.ts` — exports `POST(request)`:
  - Parse the JSON body. Validate `email` is a string matching `/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/`. Return 400 with `{ error: 'invalid email' }` on bad input.
  - Insert via `db.insert(subscribers).values({ email }).onConflictDoNothing().run()` so duplicate signups silently succeed.
  - Return `{ ok: true }` on success.

Imports: `NextResponse` from 'next/server', `db` from '@/lib/db', `subscribers` from '@/lib/schema'.

The session is incomplete unless app/api/subscribe/route.ts exists on disk.
features.acceptanceCriteria:
- app/api/subscribe/route.ts exists and exports POST
- POST /api/subscribe with {"email":"x@y.com"} returns 200 with { ok: true }
- POST without an email field returns 400
- POST with an obviously-bad string (e.g. "foo") returns 400
- Posting the same email twice does not 500 and creates only one row

features.title: Hero section with title and tagline
features.description:
ACTION: render the page hero in `app/page.tsx`.

FILE YOU MUST EDIT (use Write/Edit):
- `app/page.tsx` — replace the default Next.js scaffold with a centered hero block containing:
  - The book title `Harrowfield` rendered as a large all-caps serif heading (Tailwind: `text-5xl md:text-7xl font-serif tracking-wide uppercase`).
  - The tagline `What happened in the room below…` underneath in italic muted text (Tailwind: `italic text-lg md:text-xl text-stone-500 mt-2`).
  - Wrapper centred with vertical padding (Tailwind: `min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-start py-20 px-6`).

Keep this feature visual-only — no buttons, no fetch, no state.

The session is incomplete unless app/page.tsx is updated AND `Harrowfield` is the largest text rendered.
features.acceptanceCriteria:
- app/page.tsx renders `Harrowfield` as the largest text on the page
- The tagline appears directly under the title in italic
- Layout is centred horizontally with breathing room left/right
- npm run dev still serves the page without runtime errors

features.title: Author photo and bio block
features.description:
ACTION: add a two-column author block under the hero.

FILES YOU MUST CREATE OR EDIT:
- `public/author.jpg` — write a tiny placeholder JPEG (you can copy any small image; the user will swap their own photo in later). If you do not have an image to copy, write a 1x1 grey placeholder PNG to `public/author.png` instead and reference that file.
- `app/page.tsx` — under the hero, add a section with `flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-8 max-w-3xl mx-auto`. Left side: the photo wrapped in `rounded-2xl overflow-hidden w-72 h-72 shrink-0` with `next/image` loaded from the public file. Right side: a one-paragraph author bio (placeholder text is fine — `An archivist of vanished places. Lives in the Cotswolds with too many cats and one stubborn typewriter.` or similar) styled `font-serif text-stone-700 leading-relaxed`.

The session is incomplete unless the photo is rendered alongside the bio paragraph.
features.acceptanceCriteria:
- A photo and bio are visible directly below the hero
- They sit side-by-side on viewports >= 640px and stack vertically below 640px
- Bio is in a serif font matching the title family
- The photo file exists in public/ and is referenced via next/image

features.title: Excerpt section with fade-out
features.description:
ACTION: add the book excerpt under the author block, with a CSS mask gradient that fades the bottom of the paragraph into the page background. FILE YOU MUST EDIT (use Write/Edit): - `app/page.tsx` — under the author block, add a `
` containing one `

` with the full excerpt text: > When archivist Maren Calloway is hired to catalogue the private collection of a decommissioned Victorian asylum in the English Cotswolds, she expects damp boxes and fading paperwork. But the archive doesn't cooperate. Patient journals don't match official records. Architectural drawings show rooms with no doors. And the deeper she digs, the more the building responds. A gothic horror novel about institutional amnesia, the architecture of forgetting, and seven patients who vanished from the record but never left the stone. Wrap it in `max-w-2xl mx-auto px-6 my-16 font-serif text-lg leading-relaxed text-stone-800` and apply a Tailwind arbitrary-value mask: `[mask-image:linear-gradient(to_bottom,black_70%,transparent)] [-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to_bottom,black_70%,transparent)]`. The session is incomplete unless the excerpt visibly fades at the bottom in a browser.
features.acceptanceCriteria:
- The excerpt is one continuous paragraph in a serif font
- The bottom ~120px visibly fade to the page background
- The text content matches the spec exactly (Maren Calloway, Cotswolds, seven patients...)
- The fade is applied via mask-image (or -webkit-mask-image), not a separate <div> overlay

features.title: Newsletter signup form
features.description:
ACTION: add a centred newsletter signup form under the excerpt that POSTs to /api/subscribe.

FILE YOU MUST CREATE (use Write):
- `app/components/SignupForm.tsx` — a client component (`'use client'`) with:
  - State: `email`, `status` (`'idle' | 'submitting' | 'ok' | 'error'`), `errorMsg`.
  - On submit: regex-validate the email locally first; if it fails, set `status='error'` and `errorMsg='Please enter a valid email address.'` without firing fetch.
  - Otherwise POST to `/api/subscribe` with `{ email }`. On 200 set `status='ok'`. On 400+ set `status='error'` with the server's error text or a fallback.
  - Render: a heading `Subscribe to learn more`, a `<form>` with email input + Subscribe button (disabled while submitting), and replace the form with a thank-you message when `status==='ok'`. Show `errorMsg` inline when `status==='error'`.

Then edit `app/page.tsx` to render `<SignupForm />` under the excerpt section.

The session is incomplete unless app/components/SignupForm.tsx exists AND app/page.tsx imports it.
features.acceptanceCriteria:
- Submitting a valid email shows a thank-you confirmation in the same place the form was
- Submitting an invalid email shows an inline validation error and does not fire the network request
- Submitting an already-subscribed email shows the same thank-you (no leak about prior signup)
- A row exists in the subscribers SQLite table after a successful submit
